name: keeper
description: Agent-first cleanup for Arch: stale worktrees, AUR clones, caches and agent leftovers

scripts.gate: biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun scripts/changelog.ts --check
scripts.site:deploy: rm -rf dist/site && mkdir -p dist/site && cp site/index.html assets/wordmark.svg assets/wordmark-dark.svg assets/logo.svg assets/icon.png dist/site && wrangler pages deploy dist/site --project-name keeper --branch main
scripts.npm:first-publish: bun scripts/build.ts && bun scripts/render-npm.ts && for d in keeper-linux-x64 keeper-linux-arm64 keeper; do npm publish dist/npm/$d --access public || exit 1; done
